name: Sign in and open the mobile chat workspace
description: Verifies a member can reach the FNI chat experience on a phone.
steps: Open the FNI welcome screen
Sign in with the demo member details
Open Chats from mobile navigation
Create a group and open its conversation
Switch to dark mode and inspect the chat header, dark message canvas and composer controls
expected: The chat list remains available, and the opened conversation uses a black patterned dark-mode canvas, compact message bubbles, call controls and a composer with attachment, emoji, camera and microphone actions.

name: Use the complete emoji picker in group chat and Saved Messages
description: Verifies both supported chat composers expose the full searchable emoji picker rather than a single hard-coded emoji.
steps: Sign in and create a group
Open the group conversation and tap the emoji control
Search for a heart emoji and insert one
Open Saved Messages and open its emoji picker
Choose an emoji from a different category
expected: The emoji library provides search, categories and skin-tone choices, and selected emojis are inserted into both message drafts.

name: Record and play back a voice message
description: Verifies the microphone records actual audio and the resulting message can be played back in the conversation.
steps: Sign in and create a group
Open the group conversation and tap the microphone
Grant microphone permission when prompted
Speak briefly and tap Stop recording
Play the resulting voice message
expected: A playable audio message appears in the group conversation; denied permission or unsupported recording produces a clear explanation.

name: Save a voice recording and retain it in Saved Messages
description: Verifies a captured voice note is stored as an audio item in Saved Messages and can be played.
steps: Open Saved Messages
Start a voice recording and grant microphone access
Stop the recording
Play the saved audio item
Refresh the page and play it again
expected: The audio item is available and playable after refresh in the same browser.

name: Handle microphone denial without breaking chat
description: Verifies users receive actionable feedback when microphone access is blocked and can still send text.
steps: Block microphone access for the site
Open a group conversation and tap the microphone
Read the permission notice
Type and send a text message
expected: A clear permission-denied notice appears and text messaging remains usable.
